newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers in joint venture with Russian firm.
newsitem.headline: De Beers in joint venture with Russian firm.

text.p: Diamond giant De Beers said in a statement on Monday that it had signed an agreement to establish a diamond exploration joint venture with Russia's Northern Mining-Geological Company "Terra".

"De Beers has recently signed an agreement to establish a joint venture with a Russian company, Northern Mining-Geological Company "Terra", to undertake diamond exploration in the Arkhangelsk region of Russia," De Beers said.
Terra holds prospecting and mining licences for two areas, Tovskaya and Ust-Pinega.
The Tovskaya area is located north of Arkhangelsk, adjacent to the Lomonosov and Verkhotina areas and the Ust-Pinega area is located to the south-east of Arkhangelsk.
